name: Advanced Echem Materials Company Limited
summary: Advanced Echem Materials Company Limited, based in Taoyuan, Taiwan, specializes in the development and production of advanced chemical materials for the semiconductor and display industries. Its comprehensive product portfolio caters to both sectors. For semiconductors, it supplies materials essential for IC manufacturing, advanced packaging, clean chemical processes, CMOS image sensors, fingerprint-on-display sensors, and chip-on-film technology. Additionally, it provides critical materials for various display technologies, including TFT LCD, OLED, and micro LED. The company was established in 2003.
